headline: The FDA issued a Complete Response Letter on November 24, 2025 for AVT06, Alvotech's proposed biosimilar to Eylea (aflibercept), citing facility deficiencies. Alvotech did not announce the letter on its date.
pdufa_note: The FDA's Complete Response Letter for BLA 761435 is dated November 24, 2025 (FDA CRL file). It cites deficiencies the FDA conveyed on a Form 483 after a pre-license inspection of a facility listed in the application, and deficiencies from a Remote Regulatory Assessment of a facility, which the FDA says may need an on-site inspection before approval. None of the five releases Alvotech filed with the SEC on Form 6-K from November 24, 2025 through January 2, 2026 announces this letter. Alvotech's annual report on Form 20-F for 2025, filed March 31, 2026, states that it received Complete Response Letters from the FDA on its BLAs for AVT03, AVT05 and AVT06 (Alvotech 20-F). On June 4, 2026 Alvotech announced that it had resubmitted the AVT06 application (Alvotech release). Because the letter was not announced on its date, this page is left out of the run-up study. No PDUFA goal date is stated, so no early or late margin is given. A Complete Response Letter means the FDA will not approve the application in its present form; the sponsor can resubmit.
source_label: FDA Complete Response Letter, BLA 761435, November 24, 2025
h1: AVT06 aflibercept biosimilar (ALVO) FDA Complete Response Letter: Nov 24, 2025

headline: The FDA issued a Complete Response Letter on November 26, 2025 for BLA 761461, a second Alvotech application for AVT05, its proposed biosimilar to Simponi (golimumab), citing facility inspection deficiencies. Alvotech did not announce the letter on its date.
pdufa_note: The FDA's Complete Response Letter for BLA 761461 is dated November 26, 2025 and names the product as AVT05 (FDA CRL file). It cites deficiencies the FDA conveyed on a Form 483 after a pre-license inspection of a facility listed in the application, and asks for a Medication Guide statement on the carton and container labeling. The FDA's letter on Alvotech's other AVT05 application, BLA 761462, is dated October 31, 2025 and has its own page (ALVO, Oct 31, 2025 letter). None of the five releases Alvotech filed with the SEC on Form 6-K from November 24, 2025 through January 2, 2026 announces this letter. Alvotech's annual report on Form 20-F for 2025, filed March 31, 2026, states that it received Complete Response Letters from the FDA on its BLAs for AVT03, AVT05 and AVT06 (Alvotech 20-F). On June 4, 2026 Alvotech announced that it had resubmitted its AVT05 applications for Simponi and Simponi Aria (Alvotech release). Because the letter was not announced on its date, this page is left out of the run-up study. No PDUFA goal date is stated, so no early or late margin is given. A Complete Response Letter means the FDA will not approve the application in its present form; the sponsor can resubmit.
source_label: FDA Complete Response Letter, BLA 761461, November 26, 2025
h1: AVT05 golimumab biosimilar (ALVO) FDA Complete Response Letter: Nov 26, 2025

headline: The FDA issued a Complete Response Letter on February 26, 2026 for AMP-004, Amphastar's proposed biosimilar to NovoLog (insulin aspart), finding its pharmacokinetic data unreliable. Amphastar did not announce the letter on its date.
pdufa_note: The FDA's Complete Response Letter for BLA 761403 is dated February 26, 2026 (FDA CRL file). The letter refers to the product as I004. The FDA writes that, because of deficiencies in bioanalytical method validation and bioanalysis for insulin aspart noted on a Form 483, the pharmacokinetic data from Study API-I004-CL-B are unreliable and cannot support a finding of no clinically meaningful differences from US-licensed NovoLog, and it recommends a new pharmacokinetic study with a validated method. The letter also cites deficiencies from a pre-license inspection of a facility listed in the application. Amphastar's fourth-quarter results release the same day says it has one biosimilar insulin candidate filed with the FDA (Amphastar release, Feb 26, 2026), and its first-quarter release of May 7, 2026 says the same and does not mention a Complete Response Letter (Amphastar release, May 7, 2026). On its earnings calls on February 26 and May 7, 2026, per the call transcripts, Amphastar described the insulin aspart application (AMP-004) as still in progress, with a commercial launch planned for 2027. Because the letter was not announced on its date, this page is left out of the run-up study. No PDUFA goal date is stated, so no early or late margin is given. A Complete Response Letter means the FDA will not approve the application in its present form; the sponsor can resubmit.
source_label: FDA Complete Response Letter, BLA 761403, February 26, 2026
h1: AMP-004 insulin aspart biosimilar (AMPH) FDA Complete Response Letter: Feb 26, 2026
